messages:
jana: Hey all  planning to spend 21 days in Okinawa (May 10May 30) to help a family member. Homebase will remain US. Quick Q: will I still get the monthly WFH stipend and is there any payroll/tax/visa follow-up i should know about?

phil: welcome Q  you should still be eligible if homebase remains US, but please submit the Temporary Remote Location (TRL) so payroll can pro-rate and flag the dates.

jana: ok will do. any country-specific flags for Japan at ~3 weeks?

payroll-bot: Ticket created: #PR-8230  "Japan 21d: TRL & stipend check for jana"  assigned to akira. ETA 1 business day. :ticket:

akira: taking it. quick clarifier: will you stay on USD payroll and not open a local bank? any meetings with local customers or contractors?

jana: staying on USD payroll, no local bank, strictly family support, no client meetings.

akira: great  21 days is usually fine. payroll will pro-rate the stipend by days in-month once TRL submitted. legal rarely needs to act for <30d but i'll confirm. please attach flight or booking to the TRL.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: TRL form under Benefits -> Location Changes. Add start/end dates and any notes. If you need temporary internet or coworking, include a request for a one-time connection stipend.

jana: submitted TRL TL-6300 and attached flight confirmation. requested a one-time connection stipend in case home wifi is flaky.

payroll-bot: Update on #PR-8230  TL-6300 received, akira added note: USD payroll; awaiting legal confirmation.

akira: we can pre-authorize a connection stipend up to $125 for documented short-term needs. upload receipts and expense it after purchase.

jana: perfect, will keep laptop and may buy a local SIM if needed. any benefit changes while i'm out?

phil: no routine care abroad is covered by Redwood plans, emergency only. telehealth should work but mind timezone differences. no change to benefits for a 21-day trip.

jana: thank you! appreciate the quick turnaround.

payroll-bot: #PR-8230 last updated 2212345705: awaiting legal check (akira).
